assets.prompt: The Spitter, a stray: a snake staff. An olive (Leaf) snake with a pale Skin belly coiled twice round a Wood staff, its neck rising from the staff's head into a wedge-shaped head side-on, facing right, jaws open with Bone fangs and a forked Fire tongue; a Skin band round the shaft and a ferrule. A 32x32 body with its ferrule at the bottom (row 28), 1px dark outline, light from the top-left; the face (one eye and its brow) is a separate layer on the head. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no player colours and no Blight (its spray is drawn in the enemies' Blight by the game).
